design._why: Recorded retroactively by opening evidence/screenshots/dashboard-1280-dark.png and evidence/screenshots/dashboard-1280-light.png (both files actually opened and viewed, not inferred from source): the home route is a KPI band (Total runs / Passed / Avg score) above a list of run records with status badges, which is Metric board (numbers first, reading beats navigating), not one of the three archetypes exempt from the anti-column check. Re-open those two PNGs to check this call. Confirmed NOT a centred column by a separate machine measurement (design_audit.mjs --claims against production, evidence/design-dashboard.json): widest block 1306 of 1440px (91%), equal 67px gutters -- wide enough that the anti-column rule (requires <72% width AND equal gutters to fire) would not trigger regardless of archetype name.
